title: The Zscaler MCP server's ZCell tools: 20 reads, the customer ID, time windows, prompts and gaps

subjects.title: The Zscaler MCP server's ZCell tools: 20 reads, the customer ID, time windows, prompts and gaps
subjects.lead: The MCP server registers 20 ZCell tools, all read-only, and its tests assert both; its toolsets guide groups them into nine toolsets.
